mapper.select: SELECT * FROM announcements ORDER BY is_pinned DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO announcements (title, content, type, author, is_pinned) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{author}, #{isPinned})
mapper.update: UPDATE announcements SET title=#{title}, content=#{content}, type=#{type}, author=#{author}, is_pinned=#{isPinned} WHERE id=#{id}
